metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows the corkscrew bridge, a stretching and strengthening exercise that may end in a satisfying self pop, crack, or release.

This exercise can be done at home, requires no equipment, and may give back pain relief within seconds. 

Let us know how it works for you!
